purpose: Temporal case study of GOES-19 active-fire detection around Argentine trekking catalog sectors during the 2025-2026 fire season; not an unbiased forecast-model evaluation
source: NOAA GOES-19 ABI-L2-FDCF Full Disk, original public NetCDF, one scan per UTC hour
selection_rationale: Fixed four-month period covering the southern fire season and the officially reported January 2026 Patagonia fire activity; dates and fixed route sectors are defined without inspecting GOES labels.
sampling: First scan starting within the first twelve minutes of every UTC hour; fixed raster offsets at the eight existing Argentine catalog sectors; no selection using satellite labels
country: IGN/Georef province polygons; exclude one native raster pixel at international borders
availability: Maximum of NetCDF date_created, S3 listing LastModified and original HTTP Last-Modified; conservative proxy, not proof of first publication
target: High-quality GOES detection in the same pixel in a future scan; scan start minus issued_at equals horizon. Not ignition, propagation, route safety or detection of all physical fires
training: Exploratory temporal holdout only; no route deployment or precision claim
